curator_notes: [Tier 4 -- mechanical heuristic, NOT a verified resistance-mechanism claim] FERROSTATIN-1's DepMap-supplied target/mechanism annotation ('FERROPTOSIS INHIBITOR') contains the keyword 'FERROPTOSIS', which this build's keyword list maps to the nrf2_ferroptosis signature panel. Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (protective_resistance) in HCT116_LARGE_INTESTINE. This is a purely textual co-occurrence between the drug's own mechanism of action and the modifier's induced pathway category -- it is NOT a claim that either affects the other's resistance, has not been reviewed by a curator, and predicts no direction (recorded as interaction_type = unknown). Treat as a keyword-matched lead for someone to investigate, not as evidence.

protocol_parameters.medium: MEM (21090) + 1x MEM vitamins (11120) + 10% dialysed FBS + 2 mM L-glutamine + 25 mM D-glucose; complete media additionally contains serine 0.4 mM and glycine 0.4 mM; starvation media omit both (-SG)
protocol_parameters.in_vivo_leg: serine/glycine-depleted diet (LC-MS-confirmed drop in serum serine/glycine) in HCT116 xenografts
protocol_parameters.line_context: HCT116 p53+/+ vs isogenic p53-/-; RKO (Supp. Fig. 2); primary MEFs
protocol_parameters.readout: proliferation/viability; LC-MS metabolic flux; p53/p21 immunoblot

modifier.estimated_relative_cost_note: Specialized diet formulation; no equipment, though compliance monitoring (dietary counseling) adds some real-world overhead.

mechanism.notes: In p53+/+ HCT116 cells, serine/glycine withdrawal triggers transient p53-p21 (CDKN1A) cell-cycle arrest that promotes survival by channelling depleted serine stores into glutathione synthesis, preserving antioxidant capacity (Nature 2012). Directionality is protective for the p53-WT state under this modifier.

related.curator_notes: Modifier leg: methionine restriction remodels one-carbon metabolism/H3K4me3 in HCT116 (Mentch et al. 2015). Drug leg: 5-FU is the antimetabolite component of the FOLFOX regimen shown feasible with dietary methionine restriction in a Phase I/II colorectal-cancer trial (Durando et al. 2010, PMID 20424491; see [C3]). No cell-line-level combination viability readout exists in either source -- inferred via the shared one-carbon-metabolism/antimetabolite-sensitization mechanism and human trial precedent.

related.curator_notes: [Mechanistic Bridging -- model-generated hypothesis, not a tested result] Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (protective_resistance) in HCT116; Metformin's reported resistance mechanism runs through the same pathway (SLC7A11/xCT cystine-glutamate antiporter). Because the modifier's effect on this pathway is protective/resistance-conferring (reinforces the same pathway the drug's resistance depends on), this predicts antagonism and is logged here rather than surfaced as a synergy candidate. This combination has not been evaluated together in any cited study -- it is a candidate for testing, generated by matching independently-curated signature and resistance-mechanism evidence, not a direct or inferred empirical finding.

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: High SLC7A11/xCT expression sustains cystine import and glutathione synthesis, protecting against metformin-induced ferroptosis; metformin acts in part by destabilizing SLC7A11 via UFMylation inhibition (Yang et al. 2021, [S8] above).

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: GPX4 detoxifies lipid peroxides downstream of cystine/glutathione depletion; sufficient GPX4 activity (or an intact glutathione pool feeding it) can rescue cells from erastin's system Xc- blockade despite cystine starvation (Dixon et al. 2012; Yang et al. 2014).
